meta.name: dev-deepinit
meta.description: Deep codebase initialization — generate hierarchical AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md context files for a new project so engineering agents have full context from session start.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为新项目生成工程上下文文件，让AI助手从开始就掌握全局
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目启动时为AI助手提供完整上下文
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provide full context for AI agents when starting a new project

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在新项目或项目缺少上下文文档时，自动扫描代码库，生成结构概览、技术栈、命令等说明文件（CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md），让你每次开始都能直接使用，无需重新探索代码。
howto.when: 当你接手一个新项目、项目缺少 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 等上下文文档，或重大重构后需要更新文档时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化这个新项目的代码库上下文。
say.note: Claude 会开始扫描并生成文档。
直接生成两份核心上下文文件。

say.text: 我刚重构完，更新项目上下文文档。
say.note: Claude 会重新生成以反映最新结构。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will automatically scan your codebase for a new project or when context docs are missing, then generate hierarchical summary files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) covering structure, tech stack, commands, and conventions, so you have full context from session start.
howto.when_en: Triggered when onboarding a new project, when existing project lacks AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md context docs, or after a major refactor that invalidates old docs.

say_en.text: Initialize codebase context for this new project.
say_en.note: Claude will start scanning and generate docs.
Creates the two main context files directly.

say_en.text: I just refactored, update the project context docs.
say_en.note: Claude will regenerate to reflect the latest structure.
